title: Korean Style Roasted Sirloin Steak Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring roasted sirloin steak skewers with a bouncy texture, inspired by Jeju cuisine, and high in protein.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
Add the sirloin steak cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated steak cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with black pepper.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice or noodles.
